name: opsx-board
description: OpenSpec board: which phase you are in (propose/apply/archive), which tasks.md task is current, and every sub agent's name, model/effort, tokens and progress

language.title: Language
language.description: UI language: auto (from LC_ALL / LC_MESSAGES / LANG), en, zh-TW or ja

strict.title: Strict mode
strict.description: Refuse an Edit/Write that ticks several tasks.md tasks at once; the model must report each task through the task tool. Off, such an edit only gets a reminder.

inject_instructions.title: Inject reporting rule
inject_instructions.description: Append a "call the task tool when each task starts and finishes" rule to the openspec-apply-change skill and to the system prompt while in the apply phase.

auto_open.title: Auto-open pane
auto_open.description: Open the pane when the apply phase starts or the first sub agent spawns (drawn only in a terminal at least 144 columns wide).
